lines.zh: : 不过我知道不是每个人都这样。这大概就是 Makoto 一直劝我别再继续的原因吧。对吧，Makoto？

lines.en: scene everybodypornshop36
: Uh...yeah. I hate that guy and...anyone who would prey upon a high schooler. Even if that’s a contradictory stance to take given things I’ve said in the recent past.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。我恨那个人，也恨……任何会捕食高中生的人。就算考虑到我最近说过的话，这立场挺矛盾的。

lines.en: : So if it seems Makoto’s been hidin’ somethin’, it’s probably that. I just feel bad for holdin’ it in for so long since it’s clearly gettin’ between you guys...
lines.zh: : 所以如果 Makoto 看起来一直在藏着什么，大概就是这个。我只是觉得憋了这么久挺过意不去的，毕竟它显然在影响你们俩……

lines.en: scene everybodypornshop37
: Sniff.
lines.zh: : （抽鼻子）

lines.en: : Miku...why are you telling me this?
lines.zh: : Miku……你为什么要告诉我这些？

lines.en: : I just don’t want things gettin’ any worse for anybody else. And I don’t want you gettin’ suspicious of the people I care about for bein’ worse than they actually are.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让事情对任何人变得更糟。我也不想让你去怀疑我关心的那些人——他们其实没那么坏。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for hidin’ it, Maki. I know you’re probably disappointed in me, so...I’ll stop if you really want me to.
lines.zh: : 对不起我瞒着不说，Maki。我知道你大概对我挺失望的，所以……如果你真要我收手，我就收手。

lines.en: : In just a few years, though?...Won’t matter. I’ll be able to date whoever I want without anybody sayin’ anything. That’s just how far we are from freedom, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不过再过几年呢？……就不重要了。到时候我想跟谁交往就跟谁交往，没人会说半个字。我们离自由大概也就这么远了吧。

lines.en: : I’m...going to go clean myself up now...
lines.zh: : 我……去收拾一下自己了……

lines.en: : I’m sorry you two got wrapped up in all of this tonight...
lines.zh: : 很抱歉今晚把你俩也卷进这些事里了……

lines.en: scene everybodypornshop38
scene everybodypornshop39
: Miku, what the fuck was that?
lines.zh: : Miku，你他妈刚才那是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Lyin’s friggin’ hard. I don’t get how some people do it so often.
lines.zh: : 撒谎真他妈难。我不懂有些人怎么撒得那么顺。

lines.en: : No, I get that. But why? She was way more suspicious of me than you. You didn’t need to come up with a whole story to try and frame me as the good guy when I am absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 不，这我懂。可为什么？她怀疑的是我，比你多得多。你根本不需要编一整个故事来把我塑造成好人——我绝对不是好人。

lines.en: scene everybodypornshop40
: I know I didn’t need to. But I ain’t about to let you go and blow your cover like that because you feel bad in the moment. The heck would hidin’ it for so long be good for then?
lines.zh: : 我知道不需要。但我可不能眼睁睁看你因为一时心软就把马脚全露了。不然藏那么久还有什么意义？

lines.en: : But now things are just going to get harder for you.
lines.zh: : 可这样一来，你的日子只会更难。

lines.en: : She’ll see through all of the holes in your story soon if she doesn’t already. Then, the question will just become “why?” and we’ll be right back where we started.
lines.zh: : 她很快就会看穿你故事里的所有漏洞——如果她还没看穿的话。到那时，问题就只剩「为什么」了，然后我们又回到原点。

lines.en: : But that’ll give ya time to come up with a better plan, right? ‘Sides, what are friends for if not stickin’ up for each other when we’re about to do somethin’ stupid?
lines.zh: : 可那也给你争取到了想出更好计划的时间，不是吗？再说了，朋友不就是在我们快要干蠢事的时候互相撑一把的吗？

lines.en: scene everybodypornshop41
: Course, that’s all assumin’ she finds any holes in my story at all. For all we know, I’m actually a super convincing liar and I just never realized it?
lines.zh: : 当然，这一切的前提是她真能找出我故事里的漏洞。说不定我其实是个超有说服力的骗子，只是我自己没发现呢？

lines.en: : Miku...thank you.
lines.zh: : Miku……谢谢你。

lines.en: scene everybodypornshop42
: Makoto, if you really want to thank me, go apologize to your mom.
lines.zh: : Makoto，你要是真想谢我，就去跟你妈道歉。

lines.en: : You were really mean to her even if she did something as creepy and gross as watchin’ your secret twin suck three wangs at once.
lines.zh: : 就算她干了「看着你那个秘密双胞胎同时伺候三根鸡巴」这种又变态又恶心的事，你对她也真的太刻薄了。

lines.en: : I will...
lines.zh: : 我会的……

lines.en: scene black
: I just have something I need to set on fire first.
lines.zh: : 我只是有样东西得先烧掉。

lines.en: : Can I maybe hang onto it instead? Never know when ya can use a little blackmail.
lines.zh: : 要不先给我留着？谁也说不准什么时候能拿它敲点竹杠。

lines.en: : Hah...I’m starting to feel like you’re even more her daughter than I am.
lines.zh: : 哈……我开始觉得，你比我更像她的女儿。
